scripts.title: smooth fly
scripts.author: scriptss123321
scripts.summary: Features: - Toggle flight on/off with a button or the F key - Fly in the direction your camera is facing - Mobile support with on-screen FLY, Up and Down buttons - Works with the default mobile joystick - Clean on/off state, resets autom…
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local FLY_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.F
local SPEED = 60

local flying = false
local upHeld, downHeld = false, false
local bv, bg, conn

-- Movement vector for both keyboard (WASD) and mobile joystick
local controls = require(player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule")):GetControls()

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GUI
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FlyGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function makeButton(text, size, pos)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = size
	b.Position = pos
	b.Text = text
	b.TextScaled = true
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	b.AutoButtonColor = true
	b.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = b

	return b
end

local toggleBtn = makeButton("FLY: OFF", UDim2.fromOffset(120, 50), UDim2.new(1, -140, 0.5, -90))
local upBtn = makeButton("▲", UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), UDim2.new(1, -90, 0.5, -30))
local downBtn = makeButton("▼", UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), UDim2.new(1, -90, 0.5, 50))
upBtn.Visible = false
downBtn.Visible = false

local function updateGui()
	toggleBtn.Text = flying and "FLY: ON" or "FLY: OFF"
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = flying and Color3.fromRGB(30, 140, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	upBtn.Visible = flying
	downBtn.Visible = flying
end

-- Hold detection (touch + mouse)
local function bindHold(button, setter)
	button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			setter(true)
		end
	end)
	button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			setter(false)
		end
	end)
end

bindHold(upBtn, function(v) upHeld = v end)
bindHold(downBtn, function(v) downHeld = v end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fly logic
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	upHeld, downHeld = false, false
	if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end

	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
	updateGui()
end

local function startFly()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum then return end

	flying = true
	hum.PlatformStand = true

	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = hrp

	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bg.P = 1e4
	bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
	bg.Parent = hrp

	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local cf = camera.CFrame
		local mv = controls:GetMoveVector() -- x: right/left, z: back/forward

		local dir = cf.RightVector * mv.X + cf.LookVector * -mv.Z

		if upHeld or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
		if downHeld or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end

		bv.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * SPEED or Vector3.zero
		bg.CFrame = cf
	end)
	updateGui()
end

local function toggleFly()
	if flying then stopFly() else startFly() end
end

toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(toggleFly)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == FLY_KEY then
		toggleFly()
	end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(stopFly)
updateGui()

local function applyTheme(themeName)
    CurrentTheme = themeName
    local theme = ThemeColors[themeName]

    if RainbowConnection then RainbowConnection:Disconnect() RainbowConnection = nil end

    if themeName == "Rainbow" then
        RainbowConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local hue = (tick() % 5) / 5
            local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            TitleLabel.TextColor3 = rainbowColor
            FrameStroke.Color = rainbowColor
            MainStroke.Color = rainbowColor
            ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = rainbowColor
        end)
    else
        ModernFrame.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Bg
        HeaderBar.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header
        FrameStroke.Color = theme.Stroke
        TitleLabel.TextColor3 = theme.Text
        
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header
        MainStroke.Color = theme.Stroke
        ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = theme.Text
    end

    for _, card in ipairs(CardFrames) do
        if card and card.Parent then
            card.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card
            local s = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if s then s.Color = theme.Stroke end
        end
    end

    for _, sliderObj in ipairs(SliderElements) do
        if sliderObj.BarBg and sliderObj.FillBar then
            sliderObj.BarBg.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BarBg
            sliderObj.FillBar.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BarFill
        end
    end

    for modeKey, item in pairs(ActionBtns) do
        if item and item.Btn and item.Btn.Parent then
            local isAct = _G[modeKey]
            if not isAct then
                item.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BtnInactive
                item.Stroke.Color = theme.Stroke
            end
        end
    end

    for name, item in pairs(ThemeUIElements) do
        if name == themeName then
            item.StatusBtn.Text = "ACTIVE"
            item.StatusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            item.StatusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        else
            item.StatusBtn.Text = "SELECT"
            item.StatusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BtnInactive
            item.StatusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175)
        end
    end
end

local function createSlider(parent, title, min, max, default, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 46)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = ThemeColors.Dark.Card
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    table.insert(CardFrames, frame)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Color = ThemeColors.Dark.Stroke

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
    lbl.Text = title .. ": " .. tostring(default)
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local barBg = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
    barBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 6)
    barBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 28)
    barBg.BackgroundColor3 = ThemeColors.Dark.BarBg
    Instance.new("UICorner", barBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fillBar = Instance.new("Frame", barBg)
    fillBar.Size = UDim2.new((default - min)/(max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    fillBar.BackgroundColor3 = ThemeColors.Dark.BarFill
    Instance.new("UICorner", fillBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    table.insert(SliderElements, {BarBg = barBg, FillBar = fillBar})

    local dragging = false
    local function update(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - barBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / barBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos + 0.5)
        
        TweenService:Create(fillBar, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        }):Play()

        lbl.Text = title .. ": " .. tostring(val)
        callback(val)
    end

    barBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    return frame
end

-- ULTRA-SMOOTH ZERO-GLITCH FAST CATCH ACTION ENGINE
local function startBangAction(mode)
    stopActiveActionLoop()

    if not _G.TargetPlayerObj or not _G.TargetPlayerObj.Character then
        resetTargetStates()
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if (mode == "Back" or mode == "Face") then
        if not bangAnimTrack and hum then
            local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://148840333"
            bangAnimTrack = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
            bangAnimTrack.Looped = true
        end
        if bangAnimTrack and not bangAnimTrack.IsPlaying then
            bangAnimTrack:Play()
        end
    else
        if bangAnimTrack and bangAnimTrack.IsPlaying then
            bangAnimTrack:Stop()
        end
    end

    local timer = 0

    activeActionConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        local isStillActive = (mode == "Back" and _G.IsNormalBanging)
            or (mode == "Face" and _G.IsFaceBanging)
            or (mode == "HeadSit" and _G.IsHeadSitting)
            or (mode == "BackSit" and _G.IsBackSitting)

        if not isStillActive then
            stopActiveActionLoop()
            return
        end

        local targetChar = _G.TargetPlayerObj and _G.TargetPlayerObj.Character
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not targetChar or not myChar then return end

        local tRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tHead = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myHum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not tRoot or not myRoot or not myHum then return end

        -- Prevent ragdoll / falling / drift when target moves fast
        if myHum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or myHum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then
            myHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
        end

        if mode == "Back" or mode == "Face" then
            myHum.Sit = false
            timer = timer + (dt * _G.BangSpeed)
            local moveOffset = math.sin(timer) * _G.BangIntensity

            if mode == "Back" then
                myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.1 + moveOffset)
            elseif mode == "Face" then
                local faceBaseCF = tHead and tHead.CFrame or (tRoot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
                myRoot.CFrame = faceBaseCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.15, -1.0 - moveOffset) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
            end
        elseif mode == "HeadSit" then
            -- Normal smooth sitting without vibration/glitch
            myHum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
            myHum.Sit = true
            local headCF = tHead and tHead.CFrame or (tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 0))
            local headTopY = tHead and ((tHead.Size.Y * 0.5) + 1.15) or 1.4
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(headCF.Position + Vector3.new(0, headTopY, 0)) * (tRoot.CFrame - tRoot.CFrame.Position)
        elseif mode == "BackSit" then
            -- Normal smooth sitting behind target without vibration/glitch
            myHum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
            myHum.Sit = true
            myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.15, 1.25) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
        end

        -- Zero out residual velocity so fast target movement never flings/glitches local player
        myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end

local function startOrbitEngine()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    task.spawn(function()
        local angle = 0
        local lastSwitch = tick()
        local mapCenter = Vector3.new(math.random(-500, 500), math.random(10, 50), math.random(-500, 500))

        while (_G.IsOrbiting or _G.IsMapOrbiting) and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") do
            local dt = task.wait()
            angle = angle + (dt * _G.OrbitSpeed)
            local offsetX = math.cos(angle) * _G.OrbitDistance
            local offsetZ = math.sin(angle) * _G.OrbitDistance

            local target = _G.TargetPlayerObj

            if _G.IsOrbiting and target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local targetPos = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
                local newPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(offsetX, 0, offsetZ)
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetPos)
            elseif _G.IsMapOrbiting then
                if tick() - lastSwitch >= 0.1 then
                    mapCenter = Vector3.new(math.random(-1000, 1000), math.random(10, 40), math.random(-1000, 1000))
                    lastSwitch = tick()
                end
                local newPos = mapCenter + Vector3.new(offsetX, 0, offsetZ)
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, mapCenter)
            end
        end
    end)

local function runRCDCheck()
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

	task.wait(1)

	local testTool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool") or backpack:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

	if not testTool or not testTool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		lastStatusText = "Stopped: Need a Tool with a Handle."
		if not isMinimized then text.Text = lastStatusText end
		return
	end

	text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	lastStatusText = "Checking..."
	if not isMinimized then text.Text = lastStatusText end

	local ping = player:GetNetworkPing()

	humanoid:UnequipTools()
	task.wait(math.max(0.4, ping * 2))

	local rightArm = character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
	if rightArm then
		rightArm:Destroy()
	end

	task.wait(math.max(0.6, ping * 2.5))

	humanoid:EquipTool(testTool)
	task.wait(math.max(1.2, ping * 3 + 0.7))

	local handle = testTool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if handle and testTool.Parent == character then
		local verticalDrop = rootPart.Position.Y - handle.Position.Y
		local isFalling = handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < -2

		if verticalDrop < 2.2 and not isFalling then
			text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
			lastStatusText = "RejectCharacterDeletions: Enabled"
		else
			text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
			lastStatusText = "RejectCharacterDeletions: Disabled"
		end
	else
		text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
		lastStatusText = "RejectCharacterDeletions: Disabled"
	end

	if not isMinimized then
		text.Text = lastStatusText
	end

	task.wait(0.3)
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end

pcall(function()

		if g then g:Destroy() end

local Enabled = false
local BOX_SIZE = 10 -- ukuran awal kotak
local hue = 0
local originals = {}

local function getSize() return Vector3.new(BOX_SIZE, BOX_SIZE, BOX_SIZE) end

local function applyHead(char, big)
	local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end
	pcall(function()
		if big then
			if not originals[head] then
				originals[head] = {Size = head.Size, Transparency = head.Transparency, Material = head.Material, Color = head.Color}
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
				if s:IsA("NumberValue") and s.Name:match("Scale$") then s:Destroy() end
			end
			head.Size = getSize()
			head.Transparency = 0.3
			head.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			head.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) -- kotak putih
			head.CanCollide = false
		else
			local o = originals[head]
			if o then
				head.Size = o.Size
				head.Transparency = o.Transparency
				head.Material = o.Material
				head.Color = o.Color
				originals[head] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function applyAll(big)
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LocalPlayer then applyHead(plr.Character, big) end
	end
end

    local function startFly()

        local _,root,hum=getChar()

        if not root or not hum or flying then return false end

        flying=true

        bv=make("BodyVelocity",{MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e6,1e6,1e6),P=15000,Velocity=Vector3.zero},root)

        bg=make("BodyGyro",{MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e6,1e6,1e6),P=12000},root)

        hum.PlatformStand=true



        flyConn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

            if not flying or not root.Parent then

                stopFly()

                return

            end



            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera

            bg.CFrame=cam.CFrame

            local move=Vector3.zero



            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move=move+cam.CFrame.LookVector end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move=move-cam.CFrame.LookVector end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move=move+cam.CFrame.RightVector end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move=move-cam.CFrame.RightVector end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move=move+Vector3.new(0,1,0) end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move=move-Vector3.new(0,1,0) end



            if move.Magnitude>0 then move=move.Unit*flySpeed end

            bv.Velocity=move

        end)

        return true

    end

    local function stopVehicleFly()

    local function startVehicleFly()

        local _,_,hum=getChar()

        if not hum or not hum.SeatPart then return false end



        local seat=hum.SeatPart

        local root=seat.AssemblyRootPart or seat

        if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return false end



        vehicleFlying=true

        vehicleVelocity=make("BodyVelocity",{

            MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e8,1e8,1e8),

            P=25000,

            Velocity=Vector3.zero

        },root)



        vehicleGyro=make("BodyGyro",{

            MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e8,1e8,1e8),

            P=25000,

            D=1000,

            CFrame=root.CFrame

        },root)



        vehicleConnection=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

            if not vehicleFlying or not hum.Parent or hum.SeatPart~=seat or not root.Parent then

                stopVehicleFly()

                if vehicleFlyToggle then vehicleFlyToggle.Set(false,true) end

                return

            end



            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera

            local direction=Vector3.zero

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then direction=direction+cam.CFrame.LookVector end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then direction=direction-cam.CFrame.LookVector end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then direction=direction+cam.CFrame.RightVector end

    local function toHex(color)

        return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X",

            math.floor(color.R*255+0.5),

            math.floor(color.G*255+0.5),

            math.floor(color.B*255+0.5))

    end



    local function parseHex(value)

        value=value:gsub("#","")

        if #value~=6 or not value:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return nil end

        local r=tonumber(value:sub(1,2),16)

        local g=tonumber(value:sub(3,4),16)

        local b=tonumber(value:sub(5,6),16)

        return Color3.fromRGB(r,g,b)

    end

                    obj.TextColor3=newColor

                if obj:IsA("UIStroke") and obj.Color==oldColor then

                    obj.Color=newColor

                if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then

                    if obj.ImageColor3==oldColor then obj.ImageColor3=newColor end

            end)

        end



        logo.BackgroundColor3=C.ACCENT

    local isOpen=true

    local minimized=false

    local animToken=0



    local function setOpen(v)

        if isOpen==v then return end

        isOpen=v

        animToken=animToken+1

        local token=animToken



        if v then

            window.Visible=true

            panel.Visible=not minimized

            scale.Scale=baseScale*0.92

            TweenService:Create(scale,TweenInfo.new(0.2,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{

                Scale=baseScale

            }):Play()

        else

            tween(scale,0.15,{Scale=baseScale*0.92})

            panel.Visible=false

            task.delay(0.15,function()

                if animToken==token then window.Visible=false end

            end)

        end

    end



    local function setMinimized(v)

        minimized=v

        content.Visible=not v

        sidebar.Visible=not v

        status.Visible=not v

        panel.Visible=(not v) and isOpen

        tween(window,0.2,{

            Size=v and UDim2.fromOffset(WIN_W,64) or UDim2.fromOffset(WIN_W,WIN_H)

        })

    end

local function AnimacaoCarregamento()

            Porcentagem.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70,255,100)

    return b
end

--========================================================
-- LÓGICA DO CARRO
--========================================================
local function AcharCarro()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return nil end

    if hum and hum.SeatPart then
        local model = hum.SeatPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model and model ~= char then return model end
    end

    local menorDist = 20
    local melhor

    for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= char then
            local seat = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat",true) or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Seat",true)
            if seat then
                local part = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
                if part then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position-part.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < menorDist then
                        menorDist = dist
                        melhor = obj
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return melhor
end

local function LimparForcas()
    for _,obj in ipairs(ForcasCriadas) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then obj:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(ForcasCriadas)
end

local function Parar()
    IsFarming = false
    LimparForcas()
    Carro = nil
    Primary = nil

    if BtnFarm then
        BtnFarm.Text = "INJETAR VENENO"
        BtnFarm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45)
    end
    if Status then
        Status.Text = "Motor normal."
        Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
    end
end

local function Iniciar()
    Carro = AcharCarro()
    if not Carro then return false,"ERRO: Entre no carro!" end

    Primary = Carro.PrimaryPart or Carro:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
    if not Primary then return false,"Veículo sem peça principal." end

    LimparForcas()

    local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att.Name = "VenenoAttachment"
    att.Parent = Primary

    local vf = Instance.new("VectorForce")
    vf.Name = "VenenoImpulse"
    vf.Attachment0 = att
    vf.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    vf.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
    vf.Force = Vector3.zero
    vf.Parent = Primary

    table.insert(ForcasCriadas,att)
    table.insert(ForcasCriadas,vf)

    IsFarming = true
    return true,"VENENO INJETADO!"
end

-- FÍSICA DO VENENO (MASS INJECTION)
--========================================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not IsFarming or not Carro or not Primary then return end
    if not Carro.Parent or not Primary.Parent then Parar() return end

    local vf = Primary:FindFirstChild("VenenoImpulse")
    if not vf then Parar() return end

    local direcao = Primary.CFrame.LookVector
    local alvo = VelocidadeAlvoKMH / 3.6
    local atual = Primary.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(direcao)
    local diferenca = alvo-atual

    if diferenca > 0 then
        local aceleracao = math.clamp(diferenca*8,0,500)
        vf.Force = direcao*Primary.AssemblyMass*aceleracao
    else
        vf.Force = Vector3.zero
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- VELOCÍMETRO
--========================================================
SpeedGui = Instance.new("TextLabel")

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local speed = 0
    if Primary and Primary.Parent then
        speed = math.floor(Primary.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude*3.6)
    end

    SpeedGui.Text = speed.." KM/H"
    if speed > 250 then
        SpeedGui.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,50,50)
        SpeedStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)

        SpeedGui.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,150,0)
        SpeedStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,150,0)
    else
        SpeedGui.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
        SpeedStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,100,100)
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- BOTÃO FLUTUANTE E PAINEL COMPACTO
--========================================================
BtnF = CriarBotao(SG,"🩸",UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0),Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30),UDim2.fromOffset(44,44))

BtnF.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
CriarUICorner(BtnF,30)

local BtnScale = Instance.new("UIScale")

BtnScale.Parent = BtnF

Panel = Instance.new("Frame")

Panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,30,0.5,-95)
Panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)

Panel.Visible = false
Panel.Parent = SG

PanelScale.Parent = Panel

CriarTexto(Panel,"🩸 MOTOR VENENO V5",UDim2.new(0,8,0,5),13)

BtnFarm = CriarBotao(Panel,"INJETAR VENENO",UDim2.new(0,8,0,30),Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45))

Status = CriarTexto(Panel,"Entre no carro e injete.",UDim2.new(0,8,0,63),10)
Status.TextWrapped = true

CriarTexto(Panel,"VELOCIDADE MÁXIMA (KM/H)",UDim2.new(0,8,0,95))
BoxMult = CriarCampo(Panel,VelocidadeAlvoKMH,UDim2.new(0,8,0,118))

local Mais = CriarBotao(Panel,"+100",UDim2.new(0.51,0,0,151),Color3.fromRGB(35,75,45),UDim2.new(0.46,0,0,27))

local function AtualizarVelocidade(n)
    n = math.clamp(math.floor((n+50)/100)*100,100,LIMITE_VELOCIDADE)
    VelocidadeAlvoKMH = n
    BoxMult.Text = tostring(n)
    Status.Text = "Alvo: "..n.." KM/H"
end

BoxMult.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local n = tonumber(BoxMult.Text)
    if n then AtualizarVelocidade(n) else BoxMult.Text = tostring(VelocidadeAlvoKMH) end
end)

Menos.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() AtualizarVelocidade(VelocidadeAlvoKMH-100) end)
Mais.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() AtualizarVelocidade(VelocidadeAlvoKMH+100) end)

--========================================================
-- CONTROLE DO MOTOR
--========================================================
BtnFarm.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not IsFarming then
        local sucesso,msg = Iniciar()
        if sucesso then
            BtnFarm.Text = "PARAR MOTOR"
            BtnFarm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150,0,0)
            Status.Text = msg
        else
            Status.Text = msg
        end
    else
        Parar()
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- ARRASTAR INTERFACE
--========================================================
local function Drag(obj, alvo)
    alvo = alvo or obj
    local ativo = false
    local inicio
    local posicao

    obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            ativo = true
            inicio = input.Position
            posicao = alvo.Position
        end
    end)

    obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            ativo = false
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if ativo then
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local delta = input.Position - inicio
                alvo.Position = UDim2.new(posicao.X.Scale, posicao.X.Offset + delta.X, posicao.Y.Scale, posicao.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end
    end)
end

Drag(BtnF, BtnF)
Drag(SpeedGui, SpeedGui)

--========================================================

end

BtnF.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    if PanelAberto then

        local tweenFechar = TweenService:Create(

        tweenFechar.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not PanelAberto then
                Panel.Visible = false
            end
        end)
    else
        PanelAberto = true
        Panel.Position = UDim2.new(
            BtnF.Position.X.Scale, BtnF.Position.X.Offset + 32,
            BtnF.Position.Y.Scale, BtnF.Position.Y.Offset - 22
        )
        PanelScale.Scale = 0.2
        Panel.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(
            PanelScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Scale = 1 }
        ):Play()
    end
end)

		end
	end)
end

local function vehicle()
	local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local seat = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
	if seat and (seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") or seat:IsA("Seat")) then
		return seat.AssemblyRootPart or seat
	end

	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		local ok, parts = pcall(function()
			return root:GetConnectedParts(true)
		end)
		if ok and parts then
			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				if not part:IsDescendantOf(character) then
					return part.AssemblyRootPart or part
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local sizeRoot, sizeVec = nil, nil
local filterRoot, filterParams = nil, nil

local function boxSize(root)
	if sizeRoot == root and sizeVec then
		return sizeVec
	end
	local size = root.Size
	local model = root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if model then
		local ok, _, box = pcall(function()
			return model:GetBoundingBox()
		end)
		if ok and box and box.Magnitude < root.Size.Magnitude * 8 then
			size = box
		end
	end
	sizeRoot, sizeVec = root, size
	return size
end

local function rayFilter(root)
	if filterParams and filterRoot == root then
		return filterParams
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local ignore = {}
	local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	local model = root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if character then
		table.insert(ignore, character)
	end
	if model then
		table.insert(ignore, model)
	end

	local ok, connected = pcall(function()
		return root:GetConnectedParts(true)
	end)
	if ok and connected then
		for _, part in ipairs(connected) do
			table.insert(ignore, part)
		end
	end
	table.insert(ignore, root)
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
	filterRoot, filterParams = root, params
	return params
end

local function touchingGround(root)
	local cf = root.CFrame
	local size = boxSize(root)
	local halfY = (math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * size.X
		+ math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * size.Y
		+ math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * size.Z) * 0.5
	local origin = Vector3.new(cf.Position.X, cf.Position.Y - halfY + 0.5, cf.Position.Z)
	return Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -GROUND_PROBE, 0), rayFilter(root)) ~= nil
end

local function rotationBetween(a, b)
	local trace = a.RightVector:Dot(b.RightVector)
		+ a.UpVector:Dot(b.UpVector)
		+ a.LookVector:Dot(b.LookVector)
	return math.acos(math.clamp((trace - 1) * 0.5, -1, 1))
end

local function newEmitter(parent)
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = TEXTURE
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	emitter.LightEmission = 0
	emitter.LightInfluence = 1
	emitter.Parent = parent
	return emitter
end

local function stop()
	if not rig then return end

	local visuals = rig.visuals
	local force = rig.force
	rig = nil

	force:Destroy()

	for _, object in ipairs(visuals) do
		if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			object.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	task.delay(FADE_TIME, function()
		for _, object in ipairs(visuals) do
			object:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function start(root)
	local visuals = {}

	local force = Instance.new("VectorForce")
	force.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	force.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
	force.Force = Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyMass * GRAVITY, 0)
		+ root.CFrame.UpVector * (root.AssemblyMass * settings.push)
	force.Parent = root

	local params = rayFilter(root)

	local jets, splashes = {}, {}
	local rates = {}

	local function rate(emitter, base)
		emitter.Rate = base * settings.smoke
		table.insert(rates, { emitter = emitter, base = base })
	end

	local x, y, z = root.Size.X * 0.4, -root.Size.Y * 0.5, root.Size.Z * 0.4
	local corners = {
		Vector3.new(-x, y, -z), Vector3.new(x, y, -z),
		Vector3.new(-x, y, z), Vector3.new(x, y, z),
	}

	for _, position in ipairs(corners) do

		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Position = position
		attachment.Parent = root
		table.insert(jets, attachment)

		local jet = newEmitter(attachment)
		jet.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		jet.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.55)
		rate(jet, 120)
		jet.Speed = NumberRange.new(24, 40)
		jet.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(22, 22)
		jet.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 2.2),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.6),
		})
		jet.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		jet.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -55, 0)
		table.insert(visuals, jet)

		local splashAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		splashAttachment.Parent = root
		table.insert(visuals, splashAttachment)

		local splash = newEmitter(splashAttachment)
		splash.Enabled = false
		splash.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
		splash.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
		rate(splash, 70)
		splash.Speed = NumberRange.new(16, 32)
		splash.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(130, 130)
		splash.Drag = 5
		splash.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.8),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.4),
		})
		splash.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		splash.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -35, 0)
		table.insert(visuals, splash)

		table.insert(splashes, { attachment = splashAttachment, emitter = splash })
	end

	local rcs = {}

	local function sideJet(position, direction)
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Position = position
		attachment.Parent = root
		table.insert(visuals, attachment)

		local jet = newEmitter(attachment)
		jet.Enabled = false
		jet.EmissionDirection = direction
		jet.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.18, 0.32)
		rate(jet, 35)
		jet.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 16)
		jet.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
		jet.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		jet.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.5),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		jet.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -20, 0)
		table.insert(visuals, jet)
		return jet
	end

	rcs.front = sideJet(Vector3.new(0, 0, -root.Size.Z * 0.5 - 0.2), Enum.NormalId.Front)
	rcs.back = sideJet(Vector3.new(0, 0, root.Size.Z * 0.5 + 0.2), Enum.NormalId.Back)
	rcs.left = sideJet(Vector3.new(-root.Size.X * 0.5 - 0.2, 0, 0), Enum.NormalId.Left)
	rcs.right = sideJet(Vector3.new(root.Size.X * 0.5 + 0.2, 0, 0), Enum.NormalId.Right)

	local rigData = {
		root = root,
		force = force,
		visuals = visuals,
		jets = jets,
		splashes = splashes,
		rcs = rcs,
		rates = rates,
		params = params,
		mode = "physics",
		started = os.clock(),
		startPos = root.Position,
	}

	rig = rigData
end

local function applySmoke()
	if not rig then return end
	for _, item in ipairs(rig.rates) do
		item.emitter.Rate = item.base * settings.smoke
	end
end

	value.Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 0)
	value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
	track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 25)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Parent = row
	round(track, 2)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track
	round(fill, 2)

	local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
	knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
	knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
	knob.Parent = track
	round(knob, 4)

	local knobScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	knobScale.Parent = knob

	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.AutoButtonColor = false
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 14, 0, 20)
	hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, -7, 0, 16)
	hit.Parent = row

	hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		anim(knobScale, 0.12, { Scale = 1.4 })
	end)

	hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		anim(knobScale, 0.12, { Scale = 1 })
	end)

	local function show(number)
		local alpha = math.clamp((number - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		value.Text = fmt(number)
	end

	local function move(input)
		local width = math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		local alpha = math.clamp((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1)
		local number = math.clamp(math.floor((min + alpha * (max - min)) / step + 0.5) * step, min, max)
		show(number)
		apply(number)
	end

	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			drag = move
			move(input)
			anim(knobScale, 0.1, { Scale = 1.7 })
		end
	end)

	hit.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		anim(knobScale, 0.18, { Scale = 1.4 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end)

	show(current())
	return show
end

bind(RunService.Stepped, function(_, dt)
	dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)

	local root = vehicle()
	if not root or not root.Parent then
		stop()
		return
	end

	local onGround = touchingGround(root)
	if altDown and not onGround then
		airTime = airTime + dt
	else
		airTime = 0
	end
	local armed = altDown and not onGround and airTime >= settings.delay

	local axis = nil
	local pitch = 0
	local roll = 0
	if armed then
		if keyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then pitch = pitch + 1 end
		if keyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then pitch = pitch - 1 end
		if keyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then roll = roll + 1 end
		if keyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then roll = roll - 1 end

		if pitch ~= 0 or roll ~= 0 then
			local direction = root.CFrame.RightVector * pitch + root.CFrame.LookVector * roll
			if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
				axis = direction.Unit
			end
		end
	end

	if rig and rig.rcs then
		rig.rcs.front.Enabled = armed and pitch < 0
		rig.rcs.back.Enabled = armed and pitch > 0
		rig.rcs.left.Enabled = armed and roll < 0
		rig.rcs.right.Enabled = armed and roll > 0
	end

	local spin = 0
	if axis then
		local cap = settings.spin
		spinTime = spinTime + dt
		spin = math.min(cap, spinTime * math.max(cap * 2, 1))
	else
		spinTime = 0
	end

	if altDown then
		if not rig or rig.root ~= root then
			stop()
			start(root)
		end

		if rig.mode == "physics" then
			local mass = root.AssemblyMass
			local up = root.CFrame.UpVector
			local push = settings.push
			local maxUp = push * 1.08

			rig.force.Force = Vector3.new(0, mass * GRAVITY, 0) + up * (mass * push)

			local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				+ Vector3.new(0, GRAVITY * dt, 0)
				+ up * (push * dt)

			local along = velocity:Dot(up)
			if along > maxUp then
				velocity = velocity - up * (along - maxUp)
			end
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity

			if not axis then
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity * math.exp(-8 * dt)
			end

			if os.clock() - rig.started > 0.25 and (root.Position - rig.startPos).Magnitude < 1 then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				rig.mode = "cframe"
			end
		else
			root.CFrame = root.CFrame + root.CFrame.UpVector * (CF_SPEED * settings.push / 130 * dt)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			if not axis then
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end

		for index, splash in ipairs(rig.splashes) do
			local jet = rig.jets[index]
			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(jet.WorldPosition, Vector3.new(0, -SPLASH_RANGE, 0), rig.params)
			if hit then
				local point = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.15
				splash.attachment.Position = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
				splash.emitter.Enabled = true
			else
				splash.emitter.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	else
		stop()
	end

	if axis then
		local current = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity
		local along = current:Dot(axis)
		if along < spin then
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = current + axis * (spin - along)
		end

		local expected = spin * dt
		local moved = expected
		if spinLastCF then
			moved = rotationBetween(spinLastCF, root.CFrame)
		end
		if moved < expected * 0.9 then
			local position = root.CFrame.Position
			root.CFrame = (CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, expected - moved) * root.CFrame.Rotation) + position
		end
		spinLastCF = root.CFrame
	else
		spinLastCF = nil
	end
end)

local function makeDraggable(frame, header)
	header.Active = true
	local dragging = false
	local dragInput = nil
	local dragStartMouse = Vector2.new()
	local dragStartPos = Vector2.new()

	header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragInput = input
			dragStartMouse = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			dragStartPos = Vector2.new(frame.Position.X.Offset, frame.Position.Y.Offset)

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
					dragInput = nil
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging or input ~= dragInput then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end

		local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - dragStartMouse
		local maxX = math.max(0, screenGui.AbsoluteSize.X - frame.AbsoluteSize.X)
		local maxY = math.max(0, screenGui.AbsoluteSize.Y - frame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		local newX = math.clamp(dragStartPos.X + delta.X, 0, maxX)
		local newY = math.clamp(dragStartPos.Y + delta.Y, 0, maxY)

		frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newX, newY)
	end)
end

local function isOriginal(name)
	local lower = string.lower(name)
	for _, keyword in ipairs(ORIGINAL_KEYWORDS) do
		if string.find(lower, keyword, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function alertsEnabled(model)
	local override = alertOverride[model]
	if override ~= nil then
		return override
	end
	if isOriginal(model.Name) then
		return originalAlertsOn
	end
	return true
end

local function isPartVisible(part)
	return part.Transparency < 1 and part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 1
end

local function isModelVisible(model)
	if model:IsA("BasePart") then
		return isPartVisible(model)
	end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and isPartVisible(descendant) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function getPosition(model)
	if model:IsA("BasePart") then
		return model.Position
	end
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		return model:GetPivot().Position
	end
	local part = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	return part and part.Position
end

local function getQuery()
	local text = string.match(searchBox.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	return string.lower(text)
end

local function nameMatches(name, query)
	return query == "" or string.find(string.lower(name), query, 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function groupOf(name)
	local huntAt = string.find(string.lower(name), "hunt", 1, true)
	local base = huntAt and string.sub(name, 1, huntAt - 1) or name

	base = string.gsub(base, "_", " ")
	base = string.gsub(base, "(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2")
	base = string.gsub(base, "[%d%p]", " ")
	base = string.gsub(base, "%s+", " ")
	base = string.match(base, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")

	if base == "" then
		return OTHER_LABEL
	end

	base = string.gsub(base, "(%a)(%a*)", function(first, rest)
		return string.upper(first) .. string.lower(rest)
	end)

	if huntAt then
		return base .. " Hunt"
	end
	return base
end

local function showAlert(message)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = 20
	label.Text = message
	label.Parent = alertHolder
	makeCorner(label, 8)

	task.delay(ALERT_DURATION, function()
		local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			TextTransparency = 1,
		})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()
		label:Destroy()
	end)
end

		detailFrame.Visible = false

	alertButton.Text = "Alerts: " .. (alertsEnabled(selected) and "ON" or "OFF")

	filterButton.Text = "Visible only: " .. (visibleOnly and "ON" or "OFF")
	autoArrowButton.Text = "Search arrows: " .. (autoArrowOn and "ON" or "OFF")
end

local function setArrow(model, on)
	if on and not arrows[model] then
		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		arrow.Name = model.Name .. "_Arrow"
		arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)
		arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = "▲"
		arrow.TextColor3 = ARROW_COLOR
		arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
		arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		arrow.TextSize = 36
		arrow.Visible = false
		arrow.Parent = screenGui
		arrows[model] = arrow
	elseif not on and arrows[model] then
		arrows[model]:Destroy()
		arrows[model] = nil
	end
end

local function applySearchArrows()
	if not autoArrowOn then
		return
	end
	local query = getQuery()
	if query == "" then
		return
	end
	for model in pairs(entries) do
		if nameMatches(model.Name, query) then
			setArrow(model, true)
		end
	end
end

local function updateArrows()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		return
	end

	local viewport = cam.ViewportSize
	local center = viewport / 2
	local halfW = center.X - ARROW_EDGE_MARGIN
	local halfH = center.Y - ARROW_EDGE_MARGIN

	for model, arrow in pairs(arrows) do
		local pos = getPosition(model)
		if not pos then
			arrow.Visible = false
		else
			local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
			local target = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)

			if onScreen then
				arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(target.X, target.Y - 50)
				arrow.Rotation = 180
				arrow.Visible = true
			else
				local dir = target - center
				if screenPos.Z < 0 then
					dir = -dir
				end
				if dir.Magnitude < 0.001 then
					dir = Vector2.new(0, -1)
				end

				local dx, dy = math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Y)
				local tx = dx > 0.001 and halfW / dx or math.huge
				local ty = dy > 0.001 and halfH / dy or math.huge
				local edge = center + dir * math.min(tx, ty)

				arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(edge.X, edge.Y)
				arrow.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dir.Y, dir.X)) + 90
				arrow.Visible = true
			end
		end
	end
end

local function ensureEntry(model)
	if entries[model] then
		return entries[model]
	end

	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = model.Name
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	button.TextColor3 = COLOR_HIDDEN
	button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	button.TextSize = 16
	button.Text = model.Name
	button.Parent = listFrame
	makeCorner(button, 6)

	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		selected = model
		refreshDetail()
	end)

	entries[model] = button
	return button
end

local function forget(model)
	if entries[model] then
		entries[model]:Destroy()
		entries[model] = nil
	end
	setArrow(model, false)
	wasVisible[model] = nil
	if selected == model then
		selected = nil
		refreshDetail()
	end
end

local function collect(model)
	collected[model] = true
	forget(model)
end

local function refreshList()
	local query = getQuery()
	local buckets, labels = {}, {}

	for model, entry in pairs(entries) do
		local shown = nameMatches(model.Name, query) and (not visibleOnly or wasVisible[model] == true)
		entry.Visible = shown
		if shown then
			local label = groupOf(model.Name)
			if not buckets[label] then
				buckets[label] = {}
				table.insert(labels, label)
			end
			table.insert(buckets[label], model)
		end
	end

	table.sort(labels)

	local order = 0
	local usedHeaders = {}

	for _, label in ipairs(labels) do
		local header = headers[label]
		if not header then
			header = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			header.Name = "Separator_" .. label
			header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
			header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			header.TextColor3 = SEPARATOR_COLOR
			header.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			header.TextSize = 13
			header.Text = "- " .. label .. " -"
			header.Parent = listFrame
			headers[label] = header
		end

		order += 1
		header.LayoutOrder = order
		usedHeaders[label] = true

		local items = buckets[label]
		table.sort(items, function(a, b)
			return a.Name < b.Name
		end)
		for _, model in ipairs(items) do
			order += 1
			entries[model].LayoutOrder = order
		end
	end

	for label, header in pairs(headers) do
		if not usedHeaders[label] then
			header:Destroy()
			headers[label] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function getCandidates()
	local list, seen = {}, {}

	local function add(model)
		if model and not seen[model] and not collected[model] then
			seen[model] = true
			table.insert(list, model)
		end
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(huntFolder:GetChildren()) do
		add(child)
	end
	for n = AURORA_FIRST, AURORA_LAST do
		add(huntFolder:FindFirstChild(string.format("%s%02d", AURORA_PREFIX, n)))
	end

	return list
end

local function checkModels()
	local current = {}
	local query = getQuery()
	local searching = query ~= ""

	for _, model in ipairs(getCandidates()) do
		current[model] = true
		local visible = isModelVisible(model)
		local previous = wasVisible[model]
		local matches = searching and nameMatches(model.Name, query)

		if not entries[model] and matches and autoArrowOn then
			setArrow(model, true)
		end

		if visible and previous ~= true then
			if searching then
				if matches then
					showAlert(model.Name .. " is visible")
				end
			elseif alertsEnabled(model) then
				showAlert(model.Name .. " is visible")
			end

			if matches and autoArrowOn then
				setArrow(model, true)
			end
		end

		if not visible and previous == true then
			collect(model)
		else
			wasVisible[model] = visible
			local entry = ensureEntry(model)
			entry.TextColor3 = visible and COLOR_VISIBLE or COLOR_HIDDEN
		end
	end

	for model in pairs(entries) do
		if not current[model] then
			if arrows[model] and (query == "" or nameMatches(model.Name, query)) then
				showAlert(model.Name .. " disappeared")
			end
			forget(model)
		end
	end

	refreshList()
end

local function setMinimized(on)
	minimized = on
	if currentTween then
		currentTween:Cancel()
	end
	if not on then
		body.Visible = true
	end

	minimizeButton.Text = on and "+" or "-"

	local tween = TweenService:Create(viewerFrame, MINIMIZE_TWEEN, {
		Size = on and MINIMIZED_SIZE or EXPANDED_SIZE,
	})
	currentTween = tween
	tween.Completed:Connect(function(state)
		if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and minimized then
			body.Visible = false
		end
	end)
	tween:Play()
end

minimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setMinimized(not minimized)
end)

arrowButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if not selected then
		return
	end
	setArrow(selected, arrows[selected] == nil)
	refreshDetail()
end)

alertButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if not selected then
		return
	end
	alertOverride[selected] = not alertsEnabled(selected)
	refreshDetail()
end)

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	selected = nil
	refreshDetail()
end)

settingsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	originalAlertsOn = not originalAlertsOn
	refreshSettingsButton()
	refreshDetail()
end)

filterButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	visibleOnly = not visibleOnly
	refreshSettingsButton()
	refreshList()
end)

autoArrowButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	autoArrowOn = not autoArrowOn
	refreshSettingsButton()
	applySearchArrows()
end)

searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	applySearchArrows()
	refreshList()
end)

refreshSettingsButton()
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateArrows)

while true do
	checkModels()
	task.wait(CHECK_INTERVAL)
end

scripts.code:
-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup)
end

local function safeRequire(instance)
    if not instance then return end
    local ok, result = pcall(require, instance)
    if ok then return result end
end

local scripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local Gun = safeRequire(scripts:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemTypes"):WaitForChild("Gun"))
local controllers = scripts:WaitForChild("Controllers")
local FighterController = safeRequire(controllers:WaitForChild("FighterController"))
local DuelController = safeRequire(controllers:FindFirstChild("DuelController"))
local Utility = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Utility"))
if not (Gun and FighterController and Utility) then
    return
end

local State = {
    SilentAim = true,
    AimPart = "Smart",
    ShowFOV = true,
    FOV = 180,
    WallCheck = true,
    StickyTarget = true,
    HitChance = 100,
    MaxHitDistance = 350,
    ESP = true,
}
local lockGrace = 0.18

local Connections = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = c
    return c
end
local function getHumanoid(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end
local function isAlive(player)
    local humanoid = getHumanoid(player and player.Character)
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getLocalDuel()
    if not DuelController or not DuelController.GetDuel then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, duel = pcall(DuelController.GetDuel, DuelController, LocalPlayer)
    return ok and duel or nil
end
local function isEnemy(player)
    if not player or player == LocalPlayer then
        return false
    end
    local duel = getLocalDuel()
    if not duel or not duel.GetDueler then
        return false
    end
    local okMine, myDueler = pcall(duel.GetDueler, duel, LocalPlayer)
    local okTheirs, theirDueler = pcall(duel.GetDueler, duel, player)
    if not okMine or not okTheirs or not myDueler or not theirDueler then
        return false
    end
    local myTeam
    local theirTeam
    if myDueler.Get then
        pcall(function()
            myTeam = myDueler:Get("TeamID")
        end)
    end
    if theirDueler.Get then
        pcall(function()
            theirTeam = theirDueler:Get("TeamID")
        end)
    end
    if myTeam ~= nil and theirTeam ~= nil then
        return myTeam ~= theirTeam
    end
    return true
end
local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
RayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
RayParams.IgnoreWater = true
local function updateRayFilter()
    local list = {}
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(list, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
end
updateRayFilter()
connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
    task.defer(updateRayFilter)
end)
local function rawVisibleFrom(origin, character, part)
    if not (origin and character and part) then
        return false
    end
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, RayParams)
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end
local function visibleFrom(origin, character, part)
    if not State.WallCheck then
        return true
    end
    return rawVisibleFrom(origin, character, part)
end
local SmartParts = {
    "Head",
    "UpperTorso",
    "LowerTorso",
    "HumanoidRootPart",
    "LeftUpperArm",
    "RightUpperArm",
    "LeftUpperLeg",
    "RightUpperLeg",
}
local CurrentTargetPlayer
local CurrentTargetPart
local CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
local function targetParts(character)
    if State.AimPart ~= "Smart" then
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(State.AimPart)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
        print("Join Discord https://discord.gg/axonic")
            return {part}
        end
        return {}
    end
    local parts = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(SmartParts) do
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, part)
        end
    end
    return parts
end
local function getPartMetrics(part)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera or not part then
        return nil
    end
    local screen, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    if not onScreen or screen.Z <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
    local worldDistance = (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
    return screenDistance, worldDistance
end
local function bestPartForPlayer(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return nil
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then
        return nil
    end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local bestPart
    local bestPartScore = math.huge
    local bestScreenDistance
    local bestWorldDistance
    for _, part in ipairs(targetParts(character)) do
        local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
        if screenDistance
            and worldDistance <= State.MaxHitDistance
            and screenDistance <= State.FOV
            and visibleFrom(origin, character, part) then
            local priorityPenalty = 0
            if State.AimPart == "Smart" then
                if part.Name == "Head" then
                    priorityPenalty = 0
                elseif part.Name == "UpperTorso" then
                    priorityPenalty = 1.5
                elseif part.Name == "LowerTorso" or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    priorityPenalty = 3
                else
                    priorityPenalty = 6
                end
            end
            local partScore = screenDistance + priorityPenalty
            if partScore < bestPartScore then
                bestPartScore = partScore
                bestPart = part
                bestScreenDistance = screenDistance
                bestWorldDistance = worldDistance
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPart, bestScreenDistance, bestWorldDistance
end
local function findBestTarget()
    local bestPlayer
    local bestPart
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(player) and isAlive(player) then
            local part, screenDistance, worldDistance = bestPartForPlayer(player)
            if part then
                local score = screenDistance + worldDistance * 0.035
                if score < bestScore then
                    bestScore = score
                    bestPlayer = player
                    bestPart = part
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPlayer, bestPart
end
local function lockedTargetStillValid()
    local player = CurrentTargetPlayer
    local part = CurrentTargetPart
    if not State.StickyTarget or not player or not part then
        return false
    end
    if not player.Parent or not part.Parent or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) then
        return false
    end
    local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
    if not screenDistance then
        return false
    end
    if worldDistance > State.MaxHitDistance or screenDistance > State.FOV * 1.20 then
        return false
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if State.WallCheck and (not Camera or not visibleFrom(Camera.CFrame.Position, player.Character, part)) then
        return false
    end
    return true
end
local function acquireTarget(forceFresh)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lockedTargetStillValid() then
        CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
        return CurrentTargetPlayer, CurrentTargetPart
    end
    if (not forceFresh) and CurrentTargetPlayer and State.StickyTarget and lockGrace > 0 then
        if CurrentTargetLostAt == 0 then
            CurrentTargetLostAt = now
            return nil, nil
        end
        if now - CurrentTargetLostAt < lockGrace then
            return nil, nil
        end
    end
    local player, part = findBestTarget()
    CurrentTargetPlayer = player
    CurrentTargetPart = part
    CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
    return player, part
end
local FOVCircle
pcall(function()
    if Drawing and Drawing.new then
        FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
        FOVCircle.Filled = false
        FOVCircle.Thickness = 1
        FOVCircle.NumSides = 80
        FOVCircle.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        FOVCircle.Transparency = 0.85
    end
end)
local OriginalGunStartShooting = Gun.StartShooting
local ShotOffset = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(0.43, 0.25, 0.42))
local ShotKey0 = utf8.char(0)
local ShotKey1 = utf8.char(1)
local ShotKey2 = utf8.char(2)
local ShotKey3 = utf8.char(3)
local function buildShotPayload(origin, target, part)
    local aimCFrame = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(origin, target))
    return {
        [ShotKey0] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey1] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey2] = part,
        [ShotKey3] = ShotOffset,
    }
end
local function writeShotPayload(cameraData, payload)
    if type(cameraData) ~= "table" then
        return payload
    end
    cameraData[ShotKey0] = payload[ShotKey0]
    cameraData[ShotKey1] = payload[ShotKey1]
    cameraData[ShotKey2] = payload[ShotKey2]
    cameraData[ShotKey3] = payload[ShotKey3]
    return cameraData
end
Gun.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
    local results = table.pack(OriginalGunStartShooting(self, ...))
    if not self or not self.ClientFighter or not self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if results[1] ~= true or results[2] ~= "StartShooting" then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if not State.SilentAim or math.random(1, 100) > State.HitChance then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    local targetPlayer, part = acquireTarget(true)
    if not targetPlayer or not part or not part.Parent then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    results[3] = writeShotPayload(results[3], buildShotPayload(root.Position, part.Position, part))
    return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
end
local ESPFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
ESPFolder.Name = "_AxonicRivalsESP"
ESPFolder.Parent = Workspace
local ESPObjects = {}

local function removeESP(player)
    local entry = ESPObjects[player]
    if not entry then return end
    if entry.Highlight then entry.Highlight:Destroy() end
    if entry.Gui then entry.Gui:Destroy() end
    ESPObjects[player] = nil
end

local function enemyWeaponName(player)
    if not FighterController or not FighterController.GetFighter then return end
    local ok, fighter = pcall(FighterController.GetFighter, FighterController, player)
    if ok and fighter and fighter.EquippedItem then
        return fighter.EquippedItem.Name
    end
end

local function updateESP()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local character = player.Character
            local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not State.ESP or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) or not head then
                removeESP(player)
            else
                local entry = ESPObjects[player]
                if entry and entry.Character ~= character then
                    removeESP(player)
                    entry = nil
                end
                if not entry then
                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = "AxonicESP"
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.72
                    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                    highlight.Adornee = character
                    highlight.Parent = ESPFolder

                    local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    gui.Name = "AxonicName"
                    gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 52)
                    gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
                    gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    gui.Adornee = head
                    gui.Parent = ESPFolder

                    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    text.Name = "Text"
                    text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    text.TextSize = 14
                    text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                    text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
                    text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    text.TextWrapped = true
                    text.Parent = gui
                    entry = {Character = character, Highlight = highlight, Gui = gui, Label = text}
                    ESPObjects[player] = entry
                end

                local lines = {player.DisplayName}
                local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root and myRoot then
                    lines[1] = lines[1] .. "  |  " .. math.floor((root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude + .5) .. "m"
                end
                local humanoid = getHumanoid(character)
                local details = {}
                if humanoid then details[#details + 1] = "HP " .. math.floor(humanoid.Health + .5) end
                local weapon = enemyWeaponName(player)
                if weapon then details[#details + 1] = weapon end
                if #details > 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(details, "  |  ") end
                entry.Label.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
            end
        end
    end
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        if not player.Parent then removeESP(player) end
    end
end
connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, removeESP)

local discordGui
local lastViewport

    local parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local previous = parent:FindFirstChild("AxonicRivalsInvite")

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "AxonicRivalsInvite"
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.DisplayOrder = 100
    gui.Parent = parent
    discordGui = gui

    local theme = {
        Window = Color3.fromRGB(13, 13, 15),
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 20),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24),
        Button = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26),
        Hover = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 35),

        Text = Color3.fromRGB(242, 243, 246),
