local function isHighObstacleName(nameLower)
	return string.find(nameLower, "tree", 1, true)
		or string.find(nameLower, "leaf", 1, true)
		or string.find(nameLower, "leaves", 1, true)
		or string.find(nameLower, "foliage", 1, true)
		or string.find(nameLower, "flower", 1, true)
		or string.find(nameLower, "mushroom", 1, true)
		or string.find(nameLower, "sunflower", 1, true)
		or string.find(nameLower, "cloud", 1, true)
		or string.find(nameLower, "sky", 1, true)
end

local function detectPlayZone(force)
	local now = os.clock()
	if not force and (now - lastZoneDetectTime) < 6 then
		return
	end
	lastZoneDetectTime = now

	local minX, maxX = math.huge, -math.huge
	local minZ, maxZ = math.huge, -math.huge
	local minY, maxY = math.huge, -math.huge
	local foundAny = false

	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Anchored then
			local n = string.lower(obj.Name)
			if not isHighObstacleName(n)
				and not string.find(n, "orb", 1, true)
				and not string.find(n, "drop", 1, true)
				and not string.find(n, "barrier", 1, true)
				and not string.find(n, "border", 1, true)
				and not string.find(n, "edge", 1, true)
				and not string.find(n, "wall", 1, true)
				and not string.find(n, "kill", 1, true)
				and (obj.Size.X > 16 or obj.Size.Z > 16) then
				foundAny = true
				minX = math.min(minX, obj.Position.X - (obj.Size.X * 0.5))
				maxX = math.max(maxX, obj.Position.X + (obj.Size.X * 0.5))
				minZ = math.min(minZ, obj.Position.Z - (obj.Size.Z * 0.5))
				maxZ = math.max(maxZ, obj.Position.Z + (obj.Size.Z * 0.5))
				minY = math.min(minY, obj.Position.Y - (obj.Size.Y * 0.5))
				maxY = math.max(maxY, obj.Position.Y + (obj.Size.Y * 0.5))
			end
		end
	end

	if foundAny and minX < maxX and minZ < maxZ then
		local spanX = maxX - minX
		local spanZ = maxZ - minZ
		local insetX = math.min(PlayableInset, spanX * 0.18)
		local insetZ = math.min(PlayableInset, spanZ * 0.18)

		PlayZone.MinX = minX + insetX
		PlayZone.MaxX = maxX - insetX
		PlayZone.MinZ = minZ + insetZ
		PlayZone.MaxZ = maxZ - insetZ
		PlayZone.MinY = minY
		PlayZone.MaxY = math.min(maxY + 45, 260)
	end
end

local function clampInsidePlayZoneXZ(x, z)
	return math.clamp(x, PlayZone.MinX, PlayZone.MaxX), math.clamp(z, PlayZone.MinZ, PlayZone.MaxZ)
end

local function isInsidePlayZone(pos)
	return pos.X >= PlayZone.MinX and pos.X <= PlayZone.MaxX
		and pos.Z >= PlayZone.MinZ and pos.Z <= PlayZone.MaxZ
		and pos.Y >= (PlayZone.MinY - 15) and pos.Y <= PlayZone.MaxY
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- [ تطوير النملة بدون كسر دورة المسح ]
---------------------------------------------------------
local function triggerEvolve()
	if IsEvolvingNow then return false end
	IsEvolvingNow = true

	if not EvolveRemote then
		local r = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AntRemotes")
		EvolveRemote = r and r:FindFirstChild("Evolve")
	end
	if not EvolveRemote then
		IsEvolvingNow = false
		return false
	end

	local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
	local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local prevAnchored = hrp and hrp.Anchored or false

	if hrp then
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.Anchored = true
	end

	local ok = pcall(function()
		EvolveRemote:InvokeServer()
	end)

	if hrp and hrp.Parent then
		hrp.Anchored = prevAnchored
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	IsEvolvingNow = false
	return ok
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- [ قياس حجم النملة وحساب الهضبات بدقة ]
---------------------------------------------------------
local function getAntScale(ch)
	if not ch then return 1 end
	local scale = 1

	local attrScale = ch:GetAttribute("Scale") or ch:GetAttribute("AntScale") or ch:GetAttribute("Size")
	if type(attrScale) == "number" and attrScale > 0 then
		scale = attrScale
	end

	local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		local bodyScale = hum:FindFirstChild("BodyHeightScale") or hum:FindFirstChild("BodyProportionScale")
		if bodyScale and bodyScale:IsA("NumberValue") and bodyScale.Value > 0 then
			scale = math.max(scale, bodyScale.Value)
		end
		if hum.HipHeight and hum.HipHeight > 0 then
			scale = math.max(scale, hum.HipHeight / 2)
		end
	end

	local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		local sizeScale = hrp.Size.Y / 2
		if sizeScale > 0.1 then
			scale = math.max(scale, sizeScale)
		end
	end

	return math.clamp(scale, 0.15, 25)
end

local function getAntGroundOffset(ch)
	if not ch then return 0.8 end
	local scale = getAntScale(ch)
	local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local halfRoot = hrp and (hrp.Size.Y * 0.5) or (0.5 * scale)
	local hipHeight = (hum and hum.HipHeight > 0) and hum.HipHeight or (0.35 * scale)
	local exactFootDist = halfRoot + hipHeight
	local tinyMargin = math.clamp(0.15 * scale, 0.08, 1.2)

	return math.max(exactFootDist + tinyMargin, 0.35 * scale)
end

local function isValidGroundHit(hit)
	if not hit or not hit.Instance then return false end
	if hit.Position.Y <= -550 then return false end
	if hit.Normal.Y < 0.35 then return false end
	if hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		local n = string.lower(hit.Instance.Name)
		if isHighObstacleName(n)
			or string.find(n, "orb", 1, true)
			or string.find(n, "drop", 1, true)
			or string.find(n, "barrier", 1, true)
			or string.find(n, "kill", 1, true) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function castSingleGroundRay(x, z, folder, refY)
	local cx, cz = clampInsidePlayZoneXZ(x, z)
	local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
	local scale = getAntScale(ch)
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	local ignore = {}
	if ch then table.insert(ignore, ch) end
	if folder then table.insert(ignore, folder) end
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local startY = refY and math.clamp(refY + math.max(55, 22 * scale), 35, 240) or 140
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(cx, startY, cz), Vector3.new(0, -450, 0), rp)
	if isValidGroundHit(hit) then
		return hit.Position.Y
	end

	return nil
end

local function sampleHillHeight(x, z, folder, refY)
	local cx, cz = clampInsidePlayZoneXZ(x, z)
	local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
	local scale = getAntScale(ch)
	local probe = math.clamp(1.2 * scale, 0.8, 6.0)

	local offsets = {
		{0, 0},
		{probe, 0},
		{-probe, 0},
		{0, probe},
		{0, -probe}
	}

	local highestGround = nil
	for _, pair in ipairs(offsets) do
		local y = castSingleGroundRay(cx + pair[1], cz + pair[2], folder, refY)
		if y and (not highestGround or y > highestGround) then
			highestGround = y
		end
	end

	if highestGround then
		lastValidGroundY = highestGround
		return highestGround
	end

	return lastValidGroundY
end

local function getStraightTargetPosition(orbPos, folder, currentY)
	local cx, cz = clampInsidePlayZoneXZ(orbPos.X, orbPos.Z)
	local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
	local scale = getAntScale(ch)
	local offset = getAntGroundOffset(ch)
	local groundY = sampleHillHeight(cx, cz, folder, currentY or orbPos.Y)

	local targetY = orbPos.Y
	if groundY then
		local minFloorY = groundY + offset
		local maxHover = math.max(1.2, 2.0 * scale)
		targetY = math.clamp(orbPos.Y, minFloorY, minFloorY + maxHover)
	end

	return Vector3.new(cx, math.clamp(targetY, PlayZone.MinY + 0.5, PlayZone.MaxY), cz)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- [ فحص المجلد بدون خطوة التأكد الإضافية ]
---------------------------------------------------------
local function getOrbFolder()
	return workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientOrbs")
		or workspace:FindFirstChild("Orbs")
		or workspace:FindFirstChild("Drops")
end

local function isOrbObject(obj)
	if not obj or not obj.Parent then return false end
	local n = string.lower(obj.Name)
	return string.find(n, "orb", 1, true)
		or string.find(n, "drop", 1, true)
		or string.find(n, "gem", 1, true)
		or string.find(n, "food", 1, true)
end

local function getPart(o)
	if o:IsA("BasePart") then return o end
	if o:IsA("Model") then
		if o.PrimaryPart and o.PrimaryPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			return o.PrimaryPart
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Position.Y > -600 and p.Position.Magnitude > 1 then
				return p
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function scanWholeFolder(folder)
	local list = folder and folder:GetChildren() or workspace:GetChildren()
	local orbs = {}

	for _, obj in ipairs(list) do
		if not OrbFarmEnabled or StopFarm or IsDead then break end
		if obj.Parent and (folder or isOrbObject(obj)) then
			if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart") then
				local pt = getPart(obj)
				if pt and pt.Parent and pt.Position.Y > -600 and isInsidePlayZone(pt.Position) then
					table.insert(orbs, pt)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return orbs
end

local function setFloorGuard(on)
	if FloorGuardConn then
		FloorGuardConn:Disconnect()
		FloorGuardConn = nil
	end
	if on then
		local lastGuardCheck = 0
		FloorGuardConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if not OrbFarmEnabled or StopFarm or IsDead or IsEvolvingNow then return end
			local now = os.clock()
			if (now - lastGuardCheck) < 0.08 then return end
			lastGuardCheck = now

			local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not ch or not hrp or hrp.Anchored then return end

			local folder = getOrbFolder()
			local offset = getAntGroundOffset(ch)
			local scale = getAntScale(ch)
			local cx, cz = clampInsidePlayZoneXZ(hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Z)
			local groundY = sampleHillHeight(cx, cz, folder, hrp.Position.Y)

			local outsidePlayZone = (math.abs(hrp.Position.X - cx) > 0.2) or (math.abs(hrp.Position.Z - cz) > 0.2)
			if groundY then
				local minY = groundY + offset - (0.25 * scale)
				local maxY = groundY + offset + math.max(2.0, 2.8 * scale)
				if outsidePlayZone or hrp.Position.Y < minY or hrp.Position.Y > maxY then
					hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(cx, groundY + offset, cz) * hrp.CFrame.Rotation
				end
			elseif outsidePlayZone then
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(cx, math.clamp(hrp.Position.Y, 5, 60), cz) * hrp.CFrame.Rotation
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function resetCharacterState()
	setFloorGuard(false)
	local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
	if ch then
		local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hrp then
			hrp.Anchored = false
			if hrp:FindFirstChild("AntBV") then hrp.AntBV:Destroy() end
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
		if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
	end
end

local function tweenToPoint(hrp, goalPos)
	if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or IsDead or hrp.Anchored then return end
	local diff = goalPos - hrp.Position
	local dist = diff.Magnitude
	if dist <= 0.05 then return end

	local dur = math.max(dist / math.max(OrbSpeed, 10), 0.01)
	local lookDir = Vector3.new(diff.X, 0, diff.Z)
	local goalCF = lookDir.Magnitude > 0.05
		and CFrame.lookAt(goalPos, goalPos + lookDir.Unit)
		or CFrame.new(goalPos) * hrp.CFrame.Rotation

	ActiveTween = TweenService:Create(
		hrp,
		TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{CFrame = goalCF}
	)
	ActiveTween:Play()
	ActiveTween.Completed:Wait()
	ActiveTween = nil
end

local function moveStraightToOrb(hrp, orbPos, folder)
	if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or IsDead then return end
	while IsEvolvingNow and OrbFarmEnabled and not StopFarm do
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	end
	if hrp.Anchored or not hrp.Parent then return end

	local finalGoal = getStraightTargetPosition(orbPos, folder, hrp.Position.Y)
	local startPos = hrp.Position
	local totalDist = (finalGoal - startPos).Magnitude

	if totalDist <= HillStepSize then
		tweenToPoint(hrp, finalGoal)
		return
	end

	local steps = math.ceil(totalDist / HillStepSize)
	for i = 1, steps do
		if not OrbFarmEnabled or StopFarm or IsDead or not hrp.Parent then break end
		local alpha = i / steps
		local lerpPoint = startPos:Lerp(orbPos, alpha)
		local adjustedPoint = getStraightTargetPosition(lerpPoint, folder, hrp.Position.Y)
		tweenToPoint(hrp, adjustedPoint)
	end
end

local function startScannerLoop()
	StopFarm = false
	detectPlayZone(true)

	while OrbFarmEnabled and not StopFarm and not IsDead do
		detectPlayZone(false)
		local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if not ch or not ch.Parent or not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		else
			local folder = getOrbFolder()
			hum.PlatformStand = true
			local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("AntBV") or Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
			bv.Name = "AntBV"
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
			bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)

			local orbs = scanWholeFolder(folder)
			local total = #orbs

			if total > 0 then
				for idx, pt in ipairs(orbs) do
					if not OrbFarmEnabled or StopFarm or IsDead or not ch.Parent or not hrp.Parent then break end
					if pt and pt.Parent and pt.Position.Y > -600 and isInsidePlayZone(pt.Position) then
						StatusLabel.Text = "Status: Hill Scan (" .. idx .. "/" .. total .. ")"
						StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(85, 225, 130)

						moveStraightToOrb(hrp, pt.Position, folder)
					end
				end
			else
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end
	end

	if ActiveTween then ActiveTween:Cancel() ActiveTween = nil end
	resetCharacterState()
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- [ التفاعل مع الأزرار والاختصارات ]
---------------------------------------------------------
local function toggleFarm()
	OrbFarmEnabled = not OrbFarmEnabled
	FarmBtn.Text = OrbFarmEnabled and "Scanner Orbs : ON [F]" or "Scanner Orbs : OFF [F]"
	local targetColor = OrbFarmEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(38, 168, 82) or Color3.fromRGB(205, 48, 56)
	TweenService:Create(FarmBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = targetColor}):Play()

	if OrbFarmEnabled then
		StopFarm = false
		detectPlayZone(true)
		StatusLabel.Text = "Status: Direct Hill Scan ON"
		StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(85, 225, 130)
		setFloorGuard(true)
		task.spawn(startScannerLoop)
	else
		StopFarm = true
		if ActiveTween then ActiveTween:Cancel() ActiveTween = nil end
		resetCharacterState()
		StatusLabel.Text = "Status: Stopped"
		StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 206, 225)
	end
end

local function toggleAutoEvolve()
	AutoEvolveEnabled = not AutoEvolveEnabled
	AutoEvolveBtn.Text = AutoEvolveEnabled and "Auto Evolve : ON [E]" or "Auto Evolve : OFF [E]"
	local targetColor = AutoEvolveEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(38, 168, 82) or Color3.fromRGB(205, 48, 56)
	TweenService:Create(AutoEvolveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = targetColor}):Play()
end

FarmBtn.Activated:Connect(toggleFarm)
AutoEvolveBtn.Activated:Connect(toggleAutoEvolve)
EvolveOnceBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(triggerEvolve)
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == FarmKeybind then
		toggleFarm()
	elseif input.KeyCode == EvolveKeybind then
		toggleAutoEvolve()
	elseif input.KeyCode == InstantEvolveKeybind then
		task.spawn(triggerEvolve)
	end
end)

SpeedInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local extracted = SpeedInput.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
	local num = tonumber(extracted)
	if num then
		OrbSpeed = math.clamp(math.floor(num), 10, 3000)
	end
	SpeedInput.Text = tostring(OrbSpeed)
end)

SpeedInput.Focused:Connect(function()
	SpeedInput.Text = tostring(OrbSpeed)
end)

DelayInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local extracted = DelayInput.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
	local num = tonumber(extracted)
	if num then
		EvolveDelay = math.clamp(num, 0.1, 30)
	end
	DelayInput.Text = tostring(EvolveDelay) .. "s"
end)

DelayInput.Focused:Connect(function()
	DelayInput.Text = tostring(EvolveDelay)
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while not IsDead do
		task.wait(EvolveDelay)
		if AutoEvolveEnabled and not IsDead then
			triggerEvolve()
		end
	end
end)

_G.StopAnt = function()
	IsDead = true
	OrbFarmEnabled = false
	AutoEvolveEnabled = false
	StopFarm = true
	if ActiveTween then ActiveTween:Cancel() end
	resetCharacterState()
	if ScreenGui then ScreenGui:Destroy() end
end

scripts.code:
-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]
-- This script is not verified by rscripts.net. Deal with caution.
--
-- Stay safe:
--   • Never log in on unofficial Roblox sites or lookalike domains.
--   • Real Roblox links use roblox.com (check the .com ending).
--   • Treat fake Roblox login / "claim reward" pages as phishing.
-- [[ End Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

local Players             = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService          = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui             = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService    = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace           = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage   = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local TweenService        = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local env    = getgenv()

if env.VD_Cleanup then pcall(env.VD_Cleanup) end
for _, name in ipairs({ "CustomScriptGUI", "VDInterface" }) do
    local old = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(name)
    if old then old:Destroy() end
end
if env.Violence2DESPConn then pcall(function() env.Violence2DESPConn:Disconnect() end) end
if env.ViolenceDrawings then
    for _, d in pairs(env.ViolenceDrawings) do pcall(function() d:Remove() end) end
end
env.ViolenceDrawings = nil

local connections, drawings = {}, {}
local gui

local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    connections[#connections + 1] = c
    return c
end

local alive = true
env.VD_Cleanup = function()
    alive = false
    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    for d in pairs(drawings) do pcall(function() d:Remove() end) end
    if gui then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
end

local cfg = {
    KillerESP     = false,
    SurvivorESP   = false,
    GeneratorESP  = false,
    PumpkinESP    = false,
    Tracers       = false,
    MaxDistance   = 1000,
    AutoGenerator = false,
    AutoSolveTrap = false,
}

local hidden = false

local floor, clamp, max, min = math.floor, math.clamp, math.max, math.min

local function newDrawing(class, props)
    local d = Drawing.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do d[k] = v end
    drawings[d] = true
    return d
end

local function killDrawing(d)
    drawings[d] = nil
    pcall(function() d:Remove() end)
end

local COLORS = {
    Killer   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 82, 82),
    Survivor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255),
    Pumpkin  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40),
    GenLow   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60),
    GenHigh  = Color3.fromRGB(100, 225, 130),
    Black    = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
    HpLow    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
    HpHigh   = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 120),
}

local HEAD_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
local FEET_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)

local ESP = { players = {}, gens = {}, pumpkins = {} }

local function createPlayerEntry(plr)
    local e = {
        plr = plr,
        label = plr.Name,
        shown = false,
        isKiller = false,
        box    = newDrawing("Square", { Thickness = 1, Filled = false, Visible = false }),
        hpBack = newDrawing("Line",   { Thickness = 4, Color = COLORS.Black, Transparency = 0.6, Visible = false }),
        hpBar  = newDrawing("Line",   { Thickness = 2, Visible = false }),
        name   = newDrawing("Text",   { Size = 13, Center = true, Outline = true, Font = 2, Visible = false }),
        info   = newDrawing("Text",   { Size = 12, Center = true, Outline = true, Font = 2, Visible = false }),
        tracer = newDrawing("Line",   { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.7, Visible = false }),
    }
    e.all = { e.box, e.hpBack, e.hpBar, e.name, e.info, e.tracer }
    ESP.players[plr] = e
    return e
end

local function destroyPlayerEntry(plr)
    local e = ESP.players[plr]
    if not e then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(e.all) do killDrawing(d) end
    ESP.players[plr] = nil
end

local function hideEntry(e)
    if e.shown then
        e.shown = false
        for _, d in ipairs(e.all) do d.Visible = false end
    end
end

local function createLabelEntry(extra)
    local e = {
        shown = false,
        text = newDrawing("Text", { Size = 13, Center = true, Outline = true, Font = 2, Visible = false }),
    }
    for k, v in pairs(extra) do e[k] = v end
    return e
end

local function destroyLabelEntry(e) killDrawing(e.text) end

local function hideLabel(e)
    if e.shown then
        e.shown = false
        e.text.Visible = false
    end
end

local function clearTable(t, destroyFn)
    for k, e in pairs(t) do
        destroyFn(e)
        t[k] = nil
    end
end

local function hideAllESP()
    for _, e in pairs(ESP.players) do hideEntry(e) end
    for _, e in pairs(ESP.gens) do hideLabel(e) end
    for _, e in pairs(ESP.pumpkins) do hideLabel(e) end
end

local function isKillerPlayer(plr, char)
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Killer") then return true end
    if plr:FindFirstChild("Killer") then return true end
    local team = plr.Team
    return team ~= nil and team.Name:lower():find("killer") ~= nil
end

local function scanPlayers()
    if not (cfg.KillerESP or cfg.SurvivorESP) then
        for plr in pairs(ESP.players) do destroyPlayerEntry(plr) end
        return
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player then
            local e = ESP.players[plr] or createPlayerEntry(plr)
            local char = plr.Character
            e.char = char
            e.hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            e.hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            e.isKiller = isKillerPlayer(plr, char)
        end
    end
end

local function scanWorld()
    local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")

    if cfg.GeneratorESP and map then
        local folder = map:FindFirstChild("new Generators")
        local seen = {}
        if folder then
            for _, gen in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                seen[gen] = true
                if not ESP.gens[gen] then
                    local part = gen:FindFirstChild("GeneratorBody")
                        or gen:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
                        or gen:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
                    if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        ESP.gens[gen] = createLabelEntry({ part = part })

local function drawLabel(e, pos, text, color)
    local v = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
    if v.Z <= 0 then
        hideLabel(e)
        return
    end
    local t = e.text
    if e.last ~= text then t.Text = text; e.last = text end
    if e.color ~= color then t.Color = color; e.color = color end
    t.Position = Vector2.new(floor(v.X), floor(v.Y) - 7)
    if not e.shown then t.Visible = true; e.shown = true end
end

connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
    if hidden then return end
    camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    local camPos  = camera.CFrame.Position
    local vp      = camera.ViewportSize
    local maxDist = cfg.MaxDistance

    for _, e in pairs(ESP.players) do
        local isK = e.isKiller
        local hrp, hum = e.hrp, e.hum
        local enabled = (isK and cfg.KillerESP) or (not isK and cfg.SurvivorESP)

        if not enabled or not hrp or not hum or hrp.Parent == nil or hum.Health <= 0 then
            hideEntry(e)
            continue
        end

        local pos = hrp.Position
        local dist = (pos - camPos).Magnitude
        if dist > maxDist then
            hideEntry(e)
            continue
        end

        local top = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos + HEAD_OFFSET)
        local bot = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos - FEET_OFFSET)
        if top.Z <= 0 or bot.Z <= 0 then
            hideEntry(e)
            continue
        end

        local h = floor(bot.Y - top.Y)
        if h < 6 then
            hideEntry(e)
            continue
        end
        local w = floor(h * 0.55)
        local x, y = floor(top.X - w / 2), floor(top.Y)
        local cx = x + w / 2

        local color = isK and COLORS.Killer or COLORS.Survivor
        if e.color ~= color then
            e.color = color
            e.box.Color, e.name.Color, e.info.Color, e.tracer.Color = color, color, color, color
        end

        e.box.Size = Vector2.new(w, h)
        e.box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)

        local ratio = clamp(hum.Health / max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
        local hx = x - 5
        e.hpBack.From = Vector2.new(hx, y - 1)
        e.hpBack.To   = Vector2.new(hx, y + h + 1)
        e.hpBar.From  = Vector2.new(hx, y + h)
        e.hpBar.To    = Vector2.new(hx, y + h - floor(h * ratio))
        e.hpBar.Color = COLORS.HpLow:Lerp(COLORS.HpHigh, ratio)

        local nameText = isK and ("KILLER  " .. e.label) or e.label
        if e.nameText ~= nameText then e.name.Text = nameText; e.nameText = nameText end
        e.name.Position = Vector2.new(cx, y - 16)

        local infoText = floor(dist) .. "m"
        if e.infoText ~= infoText then e.info.Text = infoText; e.infoText = infoText end
        e.info.Position = Vector2.new(cx, y + h + 2)

        if cfg.Tracers then
            e.tracer.From = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
            e.tracer.To   = Vector2.new(cx, y + h)
        end
        e.tracer.Visible = cfg.Tracers

        if not e.shown then
            e.shown = true
            e.box.Visible, e.hpBack.Visible, e.hpBar.Visible = true, true, true
            e.name.Visible, e.info.Visible = true, true
        end
    end

    for gen, e in pairs(ESP.gens) do
        local part = e.part
        if not cfg.GeneratorESP or part.Parent == nil then
            hideLabel(e)
        else
            local pos = part.Position
            local dist = floor((pos - camPos).Magnitude)
            if dist > maxDist then
                hideLabel(e)
            else
                local prog = floor(gen:GetAttribute("RepairProgress") or 0)
                local text = prog >= 100
                    and string.format("Generator - Done - %dm", dist)
                    or  string.format("Generator - %d%% - %dm", prog, dist)
                local color = prog >= 100 and COLORS.GenHigh
                    or COLORS.GenLow:Lerp(COLORS.GenHigh, clamp(prog / 100, 0, 1))
                drawLabel(e, pos, text, color)
            end
        end
    end

    for pumpkin, e in pairs(ESP.pumpkins) do
        if not cfg.PumpkinESP or pumpkin.Parent == nil then
            hideLabel(e)
        else
            local pos = pumpkin:GetPivot().Position
            local dist = floor((pos - camPos).Magnitude)
            if dist > maxDist then
                hideLabel(e)
            else
                drawLabel(e, pos, string.format("Pumpkin - %dm", dist), COLORS.Pumpkin)
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function placeAt(target, topLeft)
    local vp = gui.AbsoluteSize
    local size = target.AbsoluteSize
    local x = clamp(topLeft.X, 0, max(vp.X - size.X, 0))
    local y = clamp(topLeft.Y, 0, max(vp.Y - size.Y, 0))
    local ap = target.AnchorPoint
    local pos = target.Position
    target.Position = UDim2.new(
        pos.X.Scale, x + size.X * ap.X - vp.X * pos.X.Scale,
        pos.Y.Scale, y + size.Y * ap.Y - vp.Y * pos.Y.Scale
    )
end

local function isPointer(input)
    return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function makeDraggable(handle, target, onTap)
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startAbs, moved = false, nil, nil, nil, false

    connect(handle.InputBegan, function(input)
        if isPointer(input) then
            dragging = true
            moved = false
            dragInput = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startAbs = target.AbsolutePosition
        end
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        local valid
        if dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            valid = input == dragInput
        else
            valid = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        end
        if not valid then return end
        local d = input.Position - dragStart
        if d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
        if moved then
            placeAt(target, startAbs + Vector2.new(d.X, d.Y))
        end
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        local ended
        if dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            ended = input == dragInput
        else
            ended = input.UserInputType == dragInput.UserInputType
        end
        if not ended then return end
        dragging = false
        if not moved and onTap then onTap() end
    end)
end

        TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,

    })

    local hintLabel
    if hintText then
        hintLabel = create("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Theme.FontRegular, TextSize = 12,
            TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            Text = hintText, Parent = btn,
        })
    end

    local indicator, indicatorStroke
    if getState then
        indicator = create("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -5),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.OnText, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = btn,
        })
        corner(indicator, 5)
        indicatorStroke = create("UIStroke", {
            Color = Theme.SubText, Transparency = 0.2, Thickness = 1.2,
            ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = indicator,
        })
    end

    local hover = false
    local function paint()
        local on = getState and getState() or false
        local base = on and Theme.RowOnT or Theme.RowOffT
        tween(btn, 0.14, {
            BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.RowOn or Theme.RowOff,
            BackgroundTransparency = base - (hover and Theme.HoverDelta or 0),
        })
        local c = on and Theme.OnText or Theme.Text
        tween(label, 0.14, { TextColor3 = c })
        setIconColor(on and Theme.OnText or Theme.IconOff)
        if indicator then
            tween(indicator, 0.14, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 })
            tween(indicatorStroke, 0.14, {
                Color = on and Theme.OnText or Theme.SubText,
                Transparency = on and 0.4 or 0.2,
            })
        end
    end
    paint()

    if hasMouse then
        connect(btn.MouseEnter, function() hover = true paint() end)
        connect(btn.MouseLeave, function() hover = false paint() end)
    end
    connect(btn.MouseButton1Click, function()
        onClick()
        paint()
    end)
    return btn, hintLabel
end

        Size = fullRow(), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(), Parent = list,
    })
end

local menuOpen = true

local function setMenu(open)
    menuOpen = open
    window.Visible = open
end

local function togglePanic()
    hidden = not hidden
    gui.Enabled = not hidden
    if hidden then hideAllESP() end
end

do
    local b = makeButton(list, fullRow(), nil, "cross", "Close menu", nil, function()
        setMenu(false)
    end)
    b.LayoutOrder = nextOrder()
end

do
    local a = addToggle(list, fullRow(), nil, "target", "Auto Generator", "AutoGenerator")
    a.LayoutOrder = nextOrder()
    local b = addToggle(list, fullRow(), nil, "ban", "Auto Solve Trap", "AutoSolveTrap")
    b.LayoutOrder = nextOrder()
end

do
    local row = pairRow()
    addToggle(row, HALF, LEFT_POS,  "box",    "Killer ESP",   "KillerESP")
    addToggle(row, HALF, RIGHT_POS, "person", "Survivor ESP", "SurvivorESP")
end
do
    local row = pairRow()
    addToggle(row, HALF, LEFT_POS,  "bars",    "Generator ESP", "GeneratorESP")
    addToggle(row, HALF, RIGHT_POS, "diamond", "Pumpkin ESP",   "PumpkinESP")
end

do
    local row = pairRow()
    addToggle(row, HALF, LEFT_POS, "line", "Tracers", "Tracers")

    local ranges = {
        { label = "300m",     value = 300 },
        { label = "600m",     value = 600 },
        { label = "1000m",    value = 1000 },
        { label = "No limit", value = math.huge },
    }
    local idx = 3
    for i, r in ipairs(ranges) do if r.value == cfg.MaxDistance then idx = i end end

    local hint
    _, hint = makeButton(row, HALF, RIGHT_POS, "rings", "Range", nil, function()
        idx = idx % #ranges + 1
        cfg.MaxDistance = ranges[idx].value
        hint.Text = ranges[idx].label
    end, ranges[idx].label)
end

local fabSize = isTouch and 50 or 42

local fab = create("Frame", {
    Name = "Toggle", Active = true,
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, 0),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fabSize, fabSize),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
    BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Parent = gui,
})
corner(fab, fabSize / 2)
create("UIStroke", {
    Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.2, Thickness = 1,
    ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = fab,
})
for i = -1, 1 do
    create("Frame", {
        AnchorPoint = CENTER, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, i * 6),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 2), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Text,
        BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6, Parent = fab,
    })
end
for _, d in ipairs(fab:GetChildren()) do
    if d:IsA("Frame") then corner(d, 1) end
end

makeDraggable(fab, fab, function()
    setMenu(not menuOpen)
end)

updateScale()
connect(gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
    updateScale()
    task.defer(function()
        placeAt(window, window.AbsolutePosition)
        placeAt(fab, fab.AbsolutePosition)
    end)
end)

connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        togglePanic()
    end
end)
